newsitem.title: USA: NY airport runways blocked by Delta plane.
newsitem.headline: NY airport runways blocked by Delta plane.

text.p: The landing gear on a Delta Air Lines 727 malfunctioned after arrival at New York's La Guardia airport on Wednesday, forcing two runways to close for six hours and delaying other air traffic, officials said.

They said there was no emergency and no injuries to the 102 passengers and seven crew aboard the shuttle flight from Boston that landed at 7:19 a.m. EST (1219 GMT). All disembarked down the mobile stairways.

More than six hours later, the plane was removed from the runway on a flatbed truck and normal flight schedules resumed, said a spokeswoman for the Port Authority of New York and New Jersey, which manages the region's three major airports.

Delta spokesman Bill Berry said the pilot, after a routine landing, had reported a light came on in the cockpit indicating a landing gear problem. As a precaution, maintenance crews decided to remove the plane from the runway rather than risk the collapse of the landing gear by driving it to the terminal.
